commands.name: search
commands.summary: Search riksdagen.se by keyword. Filter by category (documents, members, web-TV, calendar, news, web pages), document type, party and riksmöte, sort the results, and page through them.

commands.name: list-members
commands.summary: List current members of parliament (ledamöter), optionally filtered by party.

commands.name: get-member
commands.summary: Get a member of parliament's profile: party, constituency, assignments and recent activity (motions, speeches, questions).

commands.name: get-party
commands.summary: Get a party page: description, leadership and members.

commands.name: get-document
commands.summary: Get a parliamentary document's detail page (motion, betänkande/committee report, föredragningslista, talarlista, etc.) including its proposals, case history, debate and decision.

commands.name: get-planned-chamber-items
commands.summary: Get the list of planned items (upcoming debates and decisions) for the Chamber (kammaren).

commands.name: get-webtv-video
commands.summary: Get a web-TV video (debate) detail: metadata, speaker list and related documents (talarlista, föredragningslista).

commands.name: get-calendar
commands.summary: Get the parliament calendar page (upcoming chamber sessions, committee meetings and events).

commands.name: get-calendar-event
commands.summary: Get a single calendar event's detail (time, place, agenda, related documents).

commands.name: list-news
commands.summary: Get the latest news (Aktuellt) from the Riksdag.

commands.name: get-news-category
commands.summary: Get a news/theme page under Aktuellt, e.g. valet-2026 or allmanna-motionstiden.

commands.name: get-page
commands.summary: Generic fallback: fetch the CMS JSON for any riksdagen.se page path, e.g. a search URL with extra filters, an open-data documentation page, or a member page with an activity filter.
